translations.web: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
translations.bsb: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding.
translations.kjv: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
translations.asv: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
